name: Okusuri ~Fukusayou ni wa Gochuui Kudasai~
original_name: おクスリ ～副作用にはご注意ください～
source:
Make love to the death with the so called ''love drug''.
When you drink the drug you become very horny, it is easy to become abnormal.
The drug has a strong side effect, it affect the mind and body.
Even you know the drug is dangerous, you cannot resist the luscious temptation that the medicine gives you.
So horny, you disturbed to a incident by the effect of the medicine.
It...... it was so naughty things.....
